Animated Map Shows Spread of Illegal Israeli Settlements Across Palestine

2026-09-14 Al Jazeera animated map, Israeli settlements, Palestine, West Bank, East Jerusalem, outposts, cartography, territorial mapping, visual explainer
Read the source article

Quick summary

Al Jazeera has published an animated map visualizing the spread of illegal Israeli settlements and outposts across Palestine, showing 163 settlements housing 744,700 settlers alongside more than 400 unauthorized outposts by 2024.

Key takeaways

  • Al Jazeera created an animated visual map showing the spread of illegal Israeli settlements and outposts
  • By 2024, 163 illegal settlements housed 744,700 Israeli settlers: 511,100 in the West Bank and 233,600 in East Jerusalem
  • More than 400 illegal outposts exist that are not officially counted but are often absorbed into recognized settlements
  • The animated map tracks the geographic expansion of settlements over time
  • The visualization also documents settler violence accompanying the settlement expansion
  • The map serves as a visual explainer of the territorial changes on the ground
